01

NVV source

The expected NVV comes from the WI Outbound Carrier. The yard value comes from O/B Actual Visit.

02

Empty equipment

Empty or MTY units are excluded from the missing-NVV yard count. They remain visible in the yard population.

03

Short steaming

Short steaming is selected manually. A GEN_CARRIER value never classifies a vessel as short steaming by itself.

04

Rehandle model

The yard snapshot position is authoritative. Loads follow WI Move Time, Queue and Sequence. Each blocker still above a target is counted once, then treated as relocated.

05

Position changes

WI and yard positions are compared separately. A mismatch is reported but does not overwrite the yard position used for the stack simulation.

06

Local processing

Source files are processed inside this browser. Saved history contains calculated results, not the uploaded Excel or TXT files.
